verdict.rationale: Fin's own integration page says it connects to business tools through MCP connectors, and a help article title describes connecting the Zapier MCP connector to Fin, so Fin acts as an MCP client. The evidence is thin: one marketing line and one article title. The Intercom MCP server docs cover the server role and earn no credit here. missing for 10: documentation for registering arbitrary or custom MCP servers, details on how Fin discovers and invokes MCP tools, auth and configuration specifics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: It works through MCP or API Data Connectors for your business tools
